impact: Shows Samsung pushing deeper into AI data-center infrastructure beyond memory; a modest positive read for AI power and cooling names like BE and for DRAM's top holding.
source: Bloomberg via Yahoo Finance / Seoul Economic Daily
summary: Bloomberg reports Samsung Electronics is in talks to acquire Modine Manufacturing, a US maker of data-center cooling systems, with a deal possible within weeks. Reported valuations range from about $5.6B to $7.5B to $8B, and neither company commented. Modine's data-center revenue rose 95% year over year to $439.7M last quarter, and its shares jumped about 25% to 29% premarket.
title: Samsung in talks to buy data-center cooling maker Modine; MOD +25%
